characters.summary: Korg is a durable Kronan warrior who fights using blunt force, heavy weaponry, and improvised melee tactics, often accompanied by his friend Miek. He possesses immense physical strength and high resilience to conventional attacks.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to certain advanced plasma or energy weapons
Can be incapacitated if physically separated into pieces (though survivable)
limitations: Relies primarily on blunt force and heavy weapons without advanced magical or energy projection capabilities.

sources.supports: Kronan physiology, durability, weapons, and feats across Thor: Ragnarok and Thor: Love and Thunder.

feats.claim: Survived being smashed and shattered into multiple pieces by Grandmaster's compliance disk and later reformed.
Wielded heavy firearms during the battle of Earth against Thanos' army.

notableResults.note: Met as a fellow gladiator on Sakaar before escaping together.
Participated in the final battle alongside the Avengers and resurrected heroes.

campaignTags.claim: Stands significantly taller and wider than an average human as a Kronan.

unknowns: Exact biological limits of Kronan limb reattachment without external assistance.

characters.continuity: Marvel Cinematic Universe films and series
characters.summary: Loki is the God of Mischief, utilizing illusion casting, shape-shifting, telekinesis, and magical dagger combat. He relies heavily on deception, misdirection, and tactical manipulation to outmaneuver physically stronger foes.
weaknesses: Prone to hubris and underestimating opponents
Physical durability can be overcome by heavy blunt force or godly strength
limitations: Illusions can be seen through or disrupted by concentrated physical or sensory attacks.

sources.supports: Loki's magic, illusion capabilities, combat history, and Frost Giant heritage.

feats.claim: Created multiple illusory duplicates of himself to confuse opponents in combat.
Faked his own death on multiple occasions using illusions.

notableResults.note: Fought on the Bifrost bridge before falling into the void.
Defeated during the invasion of New York.

campaignTags.claim: Uses Asgardian and Jotun sorceries, illusions, and magical projection.
Casts complex illusions and mind manipulation spells.

unknowns: Full extent of Frost Giant physical traits suppressed by Asgardian magic.

characters.summary: God of Stories Loki wields monumental temporal and reality-weaving magic, allowing him to manipulate dead timelines, harness raw temporal energy, and sustain the dying multiverse by hand.
weaknesses: Bound to eternal duty holding the timelines together
Not established
limitations: Requires constant physical presence at the heart of the temporal loom to maintain the multiverse.
characters.formDifferences: Transforms from standard trickster magic user into a cosmic entity capable of anchoring and sustaining all timelines in the multiverse.

sources.supports: God of Stories transformation and mastery over temporal looms and timelines.

feats.claim: Grabbed dying temporal branches and imbued them with life, weaving them into a cosmic tree at the end of time.

campaignTags.claim: Wields supreme temporal and reality-bending magic.
Weaves and repairs infinite branching timelines.

unknowns: Whether this form can engage in traditional tactical combat while tied to the multiverse throne.

characters.summary: Operating within the TVA framework with God of Stories authority, this version of Loki masters time-slipping and temporal control to navigate and rewrite events across reality.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to temporal radiation spikes before mastering time-slipping
Not established
limitations: Time-slipping requires profound mental focus and can disorient the user if triggered uncontrollably.
characters.formDifferences: Gains absolute mastery over time-slipping, allowing retroactive navigation of events while retaining TVA operational access.

sources.supports: Time-slipping mastery and TVA authority in Loki Season 2.

feats.claim: Mastered voluntary time-slipping to repeatedly attempt fixing the Temporal Loom failure.

campaignTags.claim: Uses advanced time-slipping magic to rewrite personal timeline moments.
Time-slips across different eras and locations instantaneously.

unknowns: Limits of offensive time-slipping against armed opponents.

characters.summary: Luke Cage possesses impenetrable skin and superhuman strength, allowing him to wade into melee combat with total disregard for conventional gunfire or blunt trauma.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to high-frequency sonic attacks
Can be injured by specialized Judas bullets made from Chitauri metal
limitations: Lacks ranged offensive projections; entirely dependent on close-quarters combat.

sources.supports: Luke Cage's bulletproof skin, strength feats, and weaknesses in Jessica Jones and Luke Cage.

feats.claim: Stood entirely unharmed while multiple handguns were fired directly at point-blank range.
Lifted and threw heavy vehicles with minimal effort.

notableResults.note: Defeated his half-brother in a brutal street brawl in Harlem.

unknowns: Exact upper limit of weight he can lift before muscle strain occurs.

characters.summary: M'Baku is the formidable leader of the Jabari Tribe, fighting with a traditional wooden staff and utilizing peak human physical conditioning, raw strength, and unyielding tribal combat discipline.
weaknesses: Standard human physiological limits against superhuman energy attacks
Not established
limitations: Relies strictly on physical prowess and traditional melee weaponry.

sources.supports: M'Baku's combat style, leadership of the Jabari Tribe, and appearances in Black Panther and Avengers: Endgame.

feats.claim: Fought evenly with T'Challa in ritual combat near the Warrior Falls.
Led Jabari warriors into the massive battle against Thanos' forces.

notableResults.note: Defeated in ritual combat for the Wakandan throne.

unknowns: Full durability limits without tribal armor.

characters.summary: Makkari is an Eternal endowed with superhuman speed, allowing her to run across continents in seconds, create kinetic shockwaves, and overwhelm opponents with rapid-fire physical blows before they can react.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to direct mental domination or surprise attacks when stationary
Not established
limitations: Relies on kinetic impact rather than ranged energy projection.

sources.supports: Makkari's Eternal physiology, super speed feats, and combat style in Eternals.

feats.claim: Circumnavigated the globe multiple times in mere seconds.
Engaged Ikaris in high-speed combat, tackling him through stone structures.

notableResults.note: Fought alongside fellow Eternals to stop Ikaris.

unknowns: Exact top velocity relative to light speed.

characters.summary: Mantis is an empathetic alien with the power to manipulate emotions, induce instant sleep, and read the feelings of any conscious being through physical touch.
weaknesses: Requires direct skin-to-skin physical contact to use empathy or sleep powers
Physically fragile compared to heavy combatants
limitations: Power is ineffective if physical contact cannot be established or if the target possesses overwhelming willpower/resistance.

sources.supports: Mantis' empathic powers, sleep induction feats, and physical capabilities in Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2 and Avengers: Infinity War.

feats.claim: Successfully put Thanos into a deep slumber during the confrontation on Titan.
Calmed an enraged Ego during her time on his planet.

notableResults.note: Held Thanos under sleep hypnosis until Star-Lord attacked in anger, waking him.

campaignTags.claim: Induces sleep or alters emotional states through physical touch.
Senses and projects emotional states telepathically.

unknowns: Limits of affecting multiple powerful entities simultaneously without assistance.

characters.continuity: Marvel Cinematic Universe films and series
characters.summary: Maria Hill is a seasoned S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and tactical specialist, fighting with standard firearms, military tactics, and high-level espionage training.
weaknesses: Standard human physiology with no superhuman durability or powers
Not established
limitations: Lacks innate physical or energy powers; entirely dependent on tactical gear and training.

sources.supports: Maria Hill's background as S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, tactical expertise, and equipment.

feats.claim: Piloted extraction aircraft under fire during the collapse of S.H.I.E.L.D.
Coordinated intelligence operations across multiple global crises.

notableResults.note: Infiltrated and survived Hydra's takeover of S.H.I.E.L.D.

campaignTags.claim: Pilots Quinjets and various S.H.I.E.L.D. aircraft.

unknowns: Exact combat performance in close-quarters melee against superpowered foes.

characters.summary: Miek is an insectoid gladiator who fights using cybernetic blade attachments, high agility, and swarm tactics, often paired alongside Korg.
weaknesses: Physically small and vulnerable to heavy area-of-effect attacks
Not established

sources.supports: Miek's insectoid physiology, cybernetic upgrades, and role in Thor: Ragnarok and Avengers: Endgame.

feats.claim: Fought in the Sakaaran gladiatorial arena and later joined the revolution.
Participated in the battle of Earth with an upgraded mechanical rig.

notableResults.note: Fought in the final battle on Earth.

campaignTags.claim: Fitted with cybernetic blade legs and mechanical augmentations.

unknowns: Full intelligence and language capabilities prior to wearing mechanical translation suits.
